license_required.quote: A person may not practice medicine in this State unless the person: (1) Has a certificate to practice medicine issued by the Board of Medical Licensure and Discipline

issuing_authority.value: Board of Medical Licensure and Discipline
issuing_authority.quote: The Board of Medical Licensure and Discipline has the sole authority in this State to issue certificates to practice medicine

name.value: Board of Medical Licensure and Discipline
name.quote: The Board of Medical Licensure and Discipline has the sole authority in this State to issue certificates to practice medicine

type.quote: The Board also has the sole authority in this State to issue authorizing documents to practice other specified professions or occupations regulated by this chapter, and to supervise, regulate, and discipline members of those professions and occupations.

umbrella_agency.quote: The Executive Director and other necessary staff are employees of the Division.

moral_character_required.quote: Submit to the Board a sworn or affirmed statement that the applicant: a. Has not been convicted of or has not admitted under oath to having committed a crime substantially related to the practice of medicine

degree_required.value: Doctor of Medicine or Doctor of Osteopathy
degree_required.quote: A degree of Doctor of Medicine or Doctor of Osteopathy, or an equivalent degree, from a legally incorporated medical college or school located in the United States or Canada

accrediting_body.value: American Medical Association or American Osteopathic Association
accrediting_body.quote: which medical college or school has been approved by the appropriate accrediting body of the American Medical Association or the American Osteopathic Association

required.quote: Have satisfactorily completed an internship or equivalent training in an institution, which internship or equivalent training and institution are approved by the Board

kind.quote: Have satisfactorily completed an internship or equivalent training in an institution, which internship or equivalent training and institution are approved by the Board

exams.name: Professional examination (USMLE or equivalent)
exams.notes: Written and/or clinical; must be comprehensive and in English; Board sets rules on retakes
exams.quote: The Board shall require written and/or clinical professional examination of each applicant for a certificate to practice medicine in accordance with the Board's rules and regulations.

exams.name: Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) examination
exams.notes: Required only for graduates of foreign medical schools listed in IMED
exams.quote: documentary proof that the applicant successfully passed the examination administered by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates and the Federation of State Medical Boards

interval_years.quote: Registers the certificate to practice medicine and renews it biennially

required.quote: The Board shall provide by rule or regulation for continuing education for persons certified to practice medicine or other professions or occupations pursuant to this chapter.
required.citation: § 1713. Powers and duties of the Board.

period_years.quote: proof that the certified person has met the continuing medical education requirements established by the Board
period_years.citation: § 1723. Issuance of certificate to practice; registration and registration renewal; reactivating inactive status.

value: Alzheimer's disease or other dementias (2 hours for 2027 renewal and after)

topical_requirements.quote: For professionals who are renewing their license in 2027, the Board must require, for that renewal only, that the professional have completed at least 2 hours of the total required during that reporting period of continuing education dedicated to the diagnosis, treatment, or care of patients with Alzheimer's disease or other dementias.
topical_requirements.citation: § 1713. Powers and duties of the Board.

available.quote: The applicant for whom the examination is to be waived is licensed, certified, registered, or otherwise legally authorized to practice medicine by competent authority in any other of the United States or in any other jurisdiction approved by the Board.
available.citation: § 1722. Waiver of professional examination for temporary certification, for hospital or institution staff, for physicians licensed in another jurisdiction, and for physicians passing an alternative exam.

requirements.value: Applicant must be licensed, certified, registered, or otherwise legally authorized to practice medicine in another U.S. state or approved jurisdiction; exam may be waived by Board regulation.

credential_type.quote: Certificate to practice medicine" means the authorization awarded by the Board to a person who has been qualified to practice medicine in this State by meeting the requirements of this chapter.

is_mandatory.quote: A person may not practice medicine in this State unless the person: (1) Has a certificate to practice medicine issued by the Board of Medical Licensure and Discipline

title_protection.quote: Using the designation Doctor, Doctor of Medicine, Doctor of Osteopathy, physician, surgeon, physician and surgeon, Dr., M.D., or D.O., or a similar designation, or any combination thereof, in the conduct of an occupation or profession pertaining to the prevention, diagnosis, or treatment of human disease or condition, unless the designation additionally contains the description of another branch of the healing arts for which one holds a valid license in the State.

scope_protection.quote: A person who practices or attempts to practice medicine contrary to the provisions of this chapter is guilty of a class F felony
scope_protection.citation: § 1766. Penalties [See conflicting amendment, unable to be implemented, in 75 Del. Laws, c. 161, § 5.]

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of false, fraudulent, or forged statements or documents in connection with certification, registration, licensing, or the practice of medicine.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of any false, fraudulent, or forged statement or document or the use of any fraudulent, deceitful, dishonest, or unethical practice in connection with a certification, registration, or licensing requirement of this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.citation: § 1731. Unprofessional conduct and inability to practice medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine under a false or assumed name.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The practice of medicine or other profession or occupation regulated under this chapter under a false or assumed name

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine without a certificate or other authorizing document or renewal thereof.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use, distribution, or issuance of a prescription for a dangerous or narcotic drug other than for therapeutic or diagnostic purposes.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowing or intentional performance of an act which, unless authorized by this chapter, assists an unauthorized person to practice medicine or other profession or occupation regulated under this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.citation: § 1731. Unprofessional conduct and inability to practice medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misconduct, including but not limited to sexual misconduct, incompetence, or gross negligence or pattern of negligence in the practice of medicine

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unjustified failure upon request to divulge information relevant to the authorization or competence of a person to practice medicine or other profession or occupation regulated under this chapter to the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a provision of the Medical Practice Act or a Board order or regulation that more probably than not will harm the public or an individual.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The violation of a provision of this chapter or the violation of an order or regulation of the Board related to medical procedures or to the procedures of other professions or occupations regulated under this chapter, the violation of which more probably than not will harm or injure the public or an individual
disciplinary_grounds.citation: § 1731. Unprofessional conduct and inability to practice medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Charging a grossly exorbitant fee for professional services rendered.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Charging a grossly exorbitant fee for professional or occupational services rendered
disciplinary_grounds.citation: § 1731. Unprofessional conduct and inability to practice medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension, revocation, or other disciplinary action taken by a regulatory authority in another state or territory.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension or revocation of a certificate to practice medicine or of the authorizing document to practice another profession or occupation regulated under this chapter, or other disciplinary action taken by the regulatory authority in another state or territory.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signing the death certificate of a person prior to the actual time of death.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Wilful failure to comply with §1769B of this title

definition_quote.value: "Practice of medicine" or "practice medicine" includes: a. Advertising, holding out to the public, or representing in any manner that one is authorized to practice medicine in this State; b. Offering or undertaking to prescribe, order, give, or administer any drug or medicine for the use of another person; c. Offering or undertaking to prevent or to diagnose, correct, and/or treat in any manner or by any means, methods, or devices a disease, illness, pain, wound, fracture, infirmity, defect, or abnormal physical or mental condition of another person, including the management of pregnancy and parturition; d. Offering or undertaking to perform a surgical operation upon another person; e. Rendering a written or otherwise documented medical opinion concerning the diagnosis or treatment of a person...; f. Rendering a determination of medical necessity or a decision affecting or modifying the diagnosis and/or treatment of a person; g. Using the designation Doctor, Doctor of Medicine, Doctor of Osteopathy, physician, surgeon...
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of medicine" or "practice medicine" includes: a. Advertising, holding out to the public, or representing in any manner that one is authorized to practice medicine in this State

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe, order, give, or administer drugs or medicine; electronic prescribing is required with limited exceptions; prescriptions for dangerous or narcotic drugs must be for therapeutic or diagnostic purposes.
drug_authority.quote: Offering or undertaking to prescribe, order, give, or administer any drug or medicine for the use of another person

license_status_types.quote: The Board may issue an administrative medicine license to a physician who meets all qualifications for licensure... Administrative medicine licensees may not provide medical or clinical services to or for patients

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates from schools listed in IMED must pass the ECFMG and FSMB examinations. Graduates from schools not listed in IMED must complete 3 years of ACGME-approved postgraduate residency training and pass the ECFMG and FSMB examinations. All foreign graduates must provide documentary proof that U.S./Canadian clinical rotations were conducted at accredited institutions.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: A degree of Doctor of Medicine or Doctor of Osteopathy, or an equivalent degree, from a legally incorporated medical college or school located in a country other than the United States or Canada, which medical college or school is not listed in the International Medical Education Directory (IMED), but the applicant has completed 3 years of postgraduate training in a residency program which has been approved by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education and has successfully passed the examination administered by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates and the Federation of State Medical Boards

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: the applicant has completed 3 years of postgraduate training in a residency program which has been approved by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: In the absence of a proper health-care provider-patient relationship, health-care providers are prohibited from issuing prescriptions solely in response to an internet questionnaire, an internet consult, or a telephone consult. A provider-patient relationship may be established via telehealth if the provider can meet the same standard of care as in-person.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: In the absence of a proper health-care provider-patient relationship, health-care providers are prohibited from issuing prescriptions solely in response to an internet questionnaire, an internet consult, or a telephone consult.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.citation: § 6003. Scope of practice; provider-patient relationship required.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: A health-care provider licensed in a state that has not adopted an interstate compact applicable to the health-care provider may only provide telehealth under this chapter if the health-care provider obtains an interstate telehealth registration from the Division of Professional Regulation.
telemedicine_license_available.citation: § 6002. Authorization to practice by telehealth and telemedicine.

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: "Collaborative agreement" means a written document expressing an arrangement of collaboration between a licensed physician and a physician assistant.

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants have prescriptive authority for therapeutic drugs and treatments within the scope of physician assistant practice, subject to biennial renewal. A PA working under a temporary license may not have a prescriptive practice.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: Prescriptive authority for therapeutic drugs and treatments within the scope of physician assistant practice. The physician assistant's prescriptive authority and authority to practice as a physician assistant are subject to biennial renewal upon application to the Physician Assistant Regulatory Council

max_physician_assistants_per_supervising.quote: A collaborating physician may not at any given time collaborate with more than 4 physician assistants, unless a regulation of the Board increases or decreases the number.
max_physician_assistants_per_supervising.citation: § 1771. Physician's role in collaborating with a physician assistant.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Every person to whom a certificate to practice medicine is issued has a duty to report to the Board, within 60 days, all information concerning medical malpractice claims settled or adjudicated to final judgment
malpractice_reporting_required.citation: § 1730. Duty to report unprofessional conduct and inability to practice medicine.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: Every person to whom a certificate to practice medicine is issued and health care facility as defined in § 1740 of this title has a duty to report to the Board within 30 days: a. Any partial or full removal of hospital privileges based on adverse events, unprofessional conduct or competency issues
hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.citation: § 1730. Duty to report unprofessional conduct and inability to practice medicine.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The Executive Director may defer the investigation of a report pending a reported licensee's evaluation and treatment for substance abuse or for physical or mental illness, provided sufficient safeguards exist to protect the licensee's patients and the public.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: If the Executive Director reasonably believes that a diagnostic mental or physical examination of the person under investigation is necessary, the Executive Director shall order the person to submit to an examination at the person's expense to be conducted by a physician or agency designated by the Executive Director.
compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.citation: § 1732. Investigations of complaints; Executive Director authority.

administrative_medicine_license_availabl.quote: The Board may issue an administrative medicine license to a physician who meets all qualifications for licensure, including payment of a fee set by the Division of Professional Regulation, except that an applicant for an administrative medicine license shall not be required to show that the applicant has been engaged in the active practice of medicine

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: The applicant for whom the examination is to be waived is licensed, certified, registered, or otherwise legally qualified to practice medicine in another state of the United States or in another jurisdiction, and seeks a temporary certificate to practice medicine for not less than 2 weeks nor more than 3 months for the purpose of taking charge of the practice of a person certified and registered to practice medicine in this State during the person's temporary illness or absence from this State.
locum_tenens_permit_available.citation: § 1722. Waiver of professional examination for temporary certification, for hospital or institution staff, for physicians licensed in another jurisdiction, and for physicians passing an alternative exam.
